title: MappingPackActivatedPayload
description: Payload of the MappingPackActivated event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml; class: domain). Emitted when a mapping pack of one entity is activated; feeds the pack activation history per entity (INV-REQ-980). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The entity whose mapping pack was activated.

packVersion.description: The version label of the mapping pack.

effectiveFrom.description: First day the activated pack applies.

effectiveTo.description: Last day the activated pack applies; absent when the pack is open-ended.

activatedBy.description: The user id of the person who activated the pack; never a role.
